verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-hosted software. The docs show it running from a container image or the Kubernetes/OpenShift Operator on infrastructure you choose, backed by a production database you pick, such as PostgreSQL. Users can also stay in existing LDAP/AD or custom stores through federation, so the operator decides where identity data lives. missing for 10: explicit first-party data-residency/region documentation (residency is implied by the self-hosting model rather than stated), independent or hands-on corroboration of residency-driven deployments.
